name: TrtllmBatchDecodeWithKvCacheMla
reference:
import torch
import math
LOG2E = 1.0 / math.log(2.0)
def run(query, kv_cache, block_tables, seq_lens,
            kv_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim,
            bmm1_scale=1.0, bmm2_scale=1.0, sparse_mla_top_k=0,
            cum_seq_lens_q=None, return_lse=False, return_lse_base_on_e=False):
    head_dim_qk = kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim
    cache = kv_cache.squeeze(1) if kv_cache.dim() == 4 else kv_cache
    page_size = cache.shape[1]
    q_f = query.float()
    o_dtype = query.dtype
    if cum_seq_lens_q is None:
        B, q_len, H, _ = query.shape
        o = torch.zeros(B, q_len, H, kv_lora_rank, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
        lse = torch.zeros(B, q_len, H, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
    else:
        B = cum_seq_lens_q.numel() - 1
        H = query.shape[1]
        q_len = None
        o = torch.zeros(query.shape[0], H, kv_lora_rank, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
        lse = torch.zeros(query.shape[0], H, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
    for b in range(B):
        if cum_seq_lens_q is None:
            q_batch = q_f[b]
            cur_q_len = q_len
        else:
            qs, qe = cum_seq_lens_q[b].item(), cum_seq_lens_q[b + 1].item()
            q_batch = q_f[qs:qe]
            cur_q_len = qe - qs
        for t in range(cur_q_len):
            if sparse_mla_top_k > 0:
                pages = block_tables[b, t].long()
                valid = (pages >= 0) & (pages < cache.shape[0])
                pages = pages[valid]
                if pages.numel() == 0:
                    continue
                flat = cache[pages].float().reshape(-1, head_dim_qk)
            else:
                kv_len = seq_lens[b].item()
                n_pages = (kv_len + page_size - 1) // page_size
                pages = block_tables[b, :n_pages].long()
                flat = cache[pages].float().reshape(-1, head_dim_qk)[:kv_len]
            Kn = flat[:, :kv_lora_rank]
            Kp = flat[:, kv_lora_rank:]
            q = q_batch[t]
            Qn, Qp = q[:, :kv_lora_rank], q[:, kv_lora_rank:]
            logits = (Qn @ Kn.t() + Qp @ Kp.t()) * bmm1_scale
            s2 = logits * LOG2E
            m = s2.max(dim=-1, keepdim=True).values
            e = torch.exp2(s2 - m)
            denom = e.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            out_t = (e / denom) @ Kn * bmm2_scale
            lse2 = m.squeeze(-1) + torch.log2(denom.squeeze(-1))
            if cum_seq_lens_q is None:
                o[b, t] = out_t
                lse[b, t] = lse2 / LOG2E if return_lse_base_on_e else lse2
            else:
                o[cum_seq_lens_q[b].item() + t] = out_t
                lse[cum_seq_lens_q[b].item() + t] = \
                    lse2 / LOG2E if return_lse_base_on_e else lse2
    o = o.to(o_dtype)
    if return_lse:
        return o, lse
    return o
description:
Model that performs TRTLLM-GEN batch decode MLA attention.
    FlashInfer trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla (flashinfer/mla/_core.py):
        trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla(query, kv_cache, workspace_buffer,
            qk_nope_head_dim, kv_lora_rank, qk_rope_head_dim, block_tables,
            seq_lens, max_seq_len, sparse_mla_top_k=0, bmm1_scale=..., bmm2_scale=...)
        -> o (, lse)

    torch 原生小算子拼接参考实现(与官方 trace 模板参考一致, 已逐项对照验证):
    query 为 [q_nope | q_pe] 沿 head_dim 拼接 (kv_lora_rank + qk_rope_head_dim = 576),
    kv_cache 为 [ckv | kpe] 拼接的单张量 [num_pages, page_size, 576]。
    每个请求 b 的第 t 个 query 对每个 head:
        logits = (Qn @ Kn^T + Qp @ Kp^T) * bmm1_scale
        o = softmax(logits) @ Kn * bmm2_scale      # ckv 吸收后同时作为 K 和 V
    稠密路径 (sparse_mla_top_k == 0): block_tables 为稠密 2D 页表 [B, max_pages],
        取每请求前 ceil(kv_len/page_size) 页, decode 语义无因果掩码;
    稀疏路径 (sparse_mla_top_k > 0): block_tables 为 [B, q_len, top_k] 稀疏页索引,
        无效项 (<0 或越界) 跳过, 仅对有效页做注意力。
    注:
      1. bmm1_scale 常用 softmax scale (如 1/sqrt(192), 吸收前维度), bmm2_scale 常用 1.0;
      2. lse 约定与 FlashInfer MLA kernel 族一致: 默认 base-2,
         return_lse_base_on_e=True 时转自然对数;
      3. workspace_buffer/max_seq_len/is_var_seq/enable_pdl/backend 等仅为 kernel
         调度参数, 不影响数学语义, 未纳入;
      4. sinks (softmax 分母附加项) 与 skip_softmax 稀疏未纳入;
      5. 支持 cum_seq_lens_q 的 ragged query 输入 [total_q, H, 576]。
